# Maycor Building Contractors

> Premium bathroom renovation and dental practice fit-out contractor based in
> Harrow, serving London and, for dental fit-outs, the whole UK. FMB, NICEIC,
> Gas Safe, CHAS and Constructionline accredited. Bathroom renovation:
> strip-out, plumbing, electrics, waterproofing, tiling, decorating, fittings
> and waste removal. Dental practice refurbishment: HTM 01-05 compliant
> decontamination rooms, CQC Regulation 15 premises-compliant surgery
> fit-outs, X-ray room lead lining coordinated with your Radiation Protection
> Adviser, dental chair plumbing and electrics. Typical bathroom project
> range £6,000–£20,000+. 1-year warranty on all work.
